source_text_en: A UE simultaneously connected to the same 5G Core Network of a PLMN/SNPN over a 3GPP access and a non-3GPP access shall be served by a single AMF in this 5G Core Network.
actor: UE simultaneously connected to the same 5G Core Network over 3GPP and non-3GPP access
action: be served by a single AMF in that 5G Core Network
question_ko: 동일한 5G Core Network에 3GPP access와 non-3GPP access로 동시에 연결된 UE의 AMF 구성을 설명해줘.
gold_summary_ko: 해당 UE는 그 5G Core Network에서 하나의 AMF에 의해 반드시 서비스되어야 한다.

source_text_en: A UE that accesses the 5G Core Network over a non-3GPP access shall, after UE registration, support NAS signalling with 5G Core Network control-plane functions using the N1 reference point.
actor: UE accessing the 5G Core Network over non-3GPP access
condition: after UE registration
action: support NAS signalling with 5G Core Network control-plane functions using the N1 reference point
question_ko: non-3GPP access로 5G Core Network에 접근하는 UE의 등록 후 NAS signalling 방식을 설명해줘.
gold_summary_ko: UE는 등록 후 N1 reference point를 사용해 5G Core Network control-plane function과의 NAS signalling을 반드시 지원해야 한다.

source_text_en: If the UE does not include a 5G-GUTI, the SUCI shall be used for the new registration.
condition: if the UE does not include a 5G-GUTI
action: be used for the new registration
question_ko: UE가 5G-GUTI를 포함하지 않은 경우 새 등록에 사용할 식별자를 설명해줘.
gold_summary_ko: UE가 5G-GUTI를 포함하지 않으면 새 등록에는 SUCI를 반드시 사용해야 한다.

source_text_en: Network functions within the 5GC Control Plane shall only use service-based interfaces for their interactions.
actor: network functions within the 5GC Control Plane
condition: for interactions between those network functions
action: use service-based interfaces
exception: only service-based interfaces are permitted
question_ko: 5GC Control Plane 내부 Network Function 간 상호작용 인터페이스 원칙을 설명해줘.
gold_summary_ko: 5GC Control Plane 내부 Network Function은 서로 상호작용할 때 service-based interface만 반드시 사용해야 한다.

source_text_en: Each NF Service Consumer accessing the UDR, via Nudr, shall be able to add, modify, update or delete only the data it is authorised to change.
actor: each NF Service Consumer accessing the UDR via Nudr
condition: when accessing the UDR via Nudr
action: add, modify, update, or delete data
exception: only data that the NF Service Consumer is authorized to change
question_ko: Nudr를 통해 UDR에 접근하는 NF Service Consumer의 데이터 변경 범위를 설명해줘.
gold_summary_ko: 각 NF Service Consumer는 자신에게 변경 권한이 있는 데이터만 추가·수정·갱신·삭제해야 한다.

source_text_en: When AMF allocates registration area for UE registered for Disaster Roaming service as specified in clause 5.40.4, AMF shall only consider TAIs covering the area with the Disaster Condition.
condition: when allocating a registration area for a UE registered for Disaster Roaming service
action: consider TAIs covering the area with the Disaster Condition
exception: only TAIs covering the Disaster Condition area
question_ko: Disaster Roaming service에 등록된 UE의 registration area를 AMF가 할당할 때 고려할 TAI 범위를 설명해줘.
gold_summary_ko: AMF는 해당 registration area를 할당할 때 Disaster Condition이 있는 지역을 포함하는 TAI만 반드시 고려해야 한다.

source_text_en: The AMF shall then include the message authentication code, selected NAS algorithms, NCC and generated ngKSI in the S1 mode to N1 mode NAS transparent container IE (see subclause 9.11.2.9).
action: include the message authentication code, selected NAS algorithms, NCC, and generated ngKSI in the S1 mode to N1 mode NAS transparent container IE
question_ko: S1 mode to N1 mode NAS transparent container IE에 AMF가 포함하는 보안 정보를 설명해줘.
gold_summary_ko: AMF는 해당 IE에 message authentication code, 선택한 NAS algorithm, NCC, 생성한 ngKSI를 반드시 포함해야 한다.

source_text_en: In the initial registration procedure, when the key K AUSF, is invalid, the UE shall delete the ngKSI.
condition: during the initial registration procedure when K_AUSF is invalid
action: delete the ngKSI
question_ko: initial registration 중 K_AUSF가 유효하지 않을 때 UE의 ngKSI 처리를 설명해줘.
gold_summary_ko: initial registration 중 K_AUSF가 유효하지 않으면 UE는 ngKSI를 반드시 삭제해야 한다.

source_text_en: However, when the UE operating in dual-registration mode performs an initial registration procedure, it shall take into use a 5G NAS security context and follow the handling of this security context as described in the present specification.
condition: when performing an initial registration procedure
action: take a 5G NAS security context into use and handle it as described in the specification
question_ko: dual-registration mode UE가 initial registration을 수행할 때 5G NAS security context를 어떻게 처리하는지 설명해줘.
gold_summary_ko: 해당 UE는 5G NAS security context를 반드시 사용하기 시작하고 규격에 기술된 방식으로 처리해야 한다.

source_text_en: In the present document, when the UE is required to delete an ngKSI, the UE shall set the ngKSI to the value "no key is available" and consider also the associated keys K AMF or K'AMF, 5G NAS ciphering key and 5G NAS integrity key invalid (i.e. the 5G NAS security context associated with the ngKSI as no longer valid).
condition: when the UE is required to delete an ngKSI
action: set the ngKSI to 'no key is available' and consider the associated K_AMF or K'_AMF, NAS ciphering key, and NAS integrity key invalid
question_ko: UE의 ngKSI 삭제 상황에서 ngKSI와 연관 키를 어떻게 처리하는지 설명해줘.
gold_summary_ko: UE는 ngKSI를 'no key is available'로 반드시 설정하고 연관된 K_AMF 또는 K'_AMF와 NAS 암호화·무결성 키를 무효로 간주해야 한다.

source_text_en: The AMF shall define an ngKSI for the newly derived K'AMF key such that the value field is taken from the eKSI of the KASME key and the type field is set to indicate a mapped security context and associate this ngKSI with the newly created mapped 5G NAS security context.
condition: for the newly derived K'_AMF key
action: define an ngKSI using the eKSI value field and mapped-context type field, and associate it with the new mapped 5G NAS security context
question_ko: 새로 유도한 K'_AMF에 대해 AMF가 ngKSI를 정의하고 연결하는 방식을 설명해줘.
gold_summary_ko: AMF는 eKSI의 value field와 mapped security context를 나타내는 type field로 ngKSI를 반드시 정의하고 새 mapped 5G NAS security context와 연결해야 한다.

source_text_en: When the UE operating in single-registration mode in a network supporting N26 interface has a PDN connection for emergency bearer services and has no current EPS security context, the AMF shall set 5G-IA0 and 5G-EA0 as the selected 5G NAS security algorithms in the S1 mode to N1 mode NAS transparent container IE.
condition: when a single-registration-mode UE in a network supporting N26 has an emergency-bearer PDN connection and no current EPS security context
action: set 5G-IA0 and 5G-EA0 as the selected 5G NAS security algorithms in the S1 mode to N1 mode NAS transparent container IE
question_ko: N26 지원망의 single-registration mode UE가 emergency bearer PDN connection은 있지만 현재 EPS security context가 없을 때 AMF의 알고리즘 설정을 설명해줘.
gold_summary_ko: 그 조건에서 AMF는 해당 IE의 선택된 5G NAS security algorithm을 5G-IA0과 5G-EA0으로 반드시 설정해야 한다.

source_text_en: However, each SMF may also have the capability to control both a local and a central UPF within a PDU Session.
condition: within a PDU Session
action: control both a local UPF and a central UPF
question_ko: 하나의 PDU Session에서 SMF가 local UPF와 central UPF를 제어하는 구성을 설명해줘.
gold_summary_ko: 각 SMF에는 하나의 PDU Session에서 local UPF와 central UPF를 모두 제어할 수 있는 권한이 있을 수 있다.

source_text_en: When a N5CW device performs an EAP-based access authentication procedure to connect to a trusted WLAN access network, the N5CW device may simultaneously be registered to a 5GC of a PLMN or SNPN.
condition: when performing EAP-based access authentication to connect to a trusted WLAN access network
action: simultaneously be registered to a 5GC of a PLMN or SNPN
question_ko: N5CW device가 trusted WLAN 연결을 위해 EAP 기반 access authentication을 수행할 때 5GC 등록 상태를 설명해줘.
gold_summary_ko: 그 과정에서 N5CW device는 PLMN 또는 SNPN의 5GC에 동시에 등록되어 있을 수 있다.

source_text_en: The network instance for the N6 interface (clause 5.6.12) may be indicated by the SMF to the UPF for a given PDU Session during PDU Session establishment procedure.
condition: for a given PDU Session during PDU Session establishment
action: indicate the N6-interface network instance to the UPF
question_ko: PDU Session establishment 중 N6 interface의 network instance를 UPF에 전달하는 방식을 설명해줘.
gold_summary_ko: SMF는 해당 PDU Session의 N6-interface network instance를 UPF에 표시할 수 있다.

source_text_en: A non-3GPP access network may advertise the PLMNs or SNPNs for which it supports trusted connectivity and the type of supported trusted connectivity (e.g. "5G connectivity").
action: advertise supported PLMNs or SNPNs and the supported trusted-connectivity type
exception: only PLMNs or SNPNs for which trusted connectivity is supported
question_ko: non-3GPP access network가 trusted connectivity 지원 정보를 광고하는 범위를 설명해줘.
gold_summary_ko: non-3GPP access network는 trusted connectivity를 지원하는 PLMN 또는 SNPN과 그 connectivity 유형을 광고할 수 있다.

source_text_en: UEs that are not subject to 5GS and EPC interworking may be served by entities not dedicated for interworking, i.e. by either by PGW or SMF/UPF.
actor: UEs not subject to 5GS and EPC interworking
condition: when not subject to 5GS and EPC interworking
action: be served by a PGW or by an SMF/UPF not dedicated to interworking
question_ko: 5GS와 EPC interworking 대상이 아닌 UE의 serving entity 구성을 설명해줘.
gold_summary_ko: 해당 UE는 interworking 전용이 아닌 PGW 또는 SMF/UPF에 의해 서비스될 수 있다.

source_text_en: Each N3IWF, TNGF, TWIF and W-AGF may be configured with a different TAI value or with the same TAI value as other N3IWFs, TNGFs, TWIFs and/or W-AGFs.
actor: each N3IWF, TNGF, TWIF, and W-AGF
action: be configured with a TAI value different from or the same as the value of the other listed access functions
question_ko: N3IWF, TNGF, TWIF, W-AGF 사이의 TAI value 구성 관계를 설명해줘.
gold_summary_ko: 각 기능에는 다른 기능과 서로 다른 TAI value 또는 동일한 TAI value를 구성할 수 있다.

source_text_en: In addition, the HPLMN may configure a UE with a single default configured NSSAI and consider the default configured NSSAI as valid in a PLMN for which the UE has neither a configured NSSAI nor an allowed NSSAI.
condition: in a PLMN for which the UE has neither a configured NSSAI nor an allowed NSSAI
action: configure the UE with one default configured NSSAI and consider it valid in that PLMN
exception: a single default configured NSSAI
question_ko: UE에 configured NSSAI와 allowed NSSAI가 모두 없는 PLMN에서 HPLMN의 default configured NSSAI 처리를 설명해줘.
gold_summary_ko: HPLMN은 UE에 하나의 default configured NSSAI를 구성하고 이를 해당 PLMN에서 유효한 것으로 간주할 수 있다.

source_text_en: A new 5G NAS security context may also be created during an N1 mode to N1 mode handover.
condition: during an N1 mode to N1 mode handover
action: be created
question_ko: N1 mode 간 handover 중 새로운 5G NAS security context의 생성 시점을 설명해줘.
gold_summary_ko: N1 mode에서 N1 mode로 handover하는 동안 새로운 5G NAS security context가 생성될 수 있다.

source_text_en: The default configured NSSAI may be changed by sending a UE parameters update transparent container to the UE during the NAS transport procedure.
condition: during the NAS transport procedure
action: be changed by sending a UE parameters update transparent container to the UE
question_ko: NAS transport procedure 중 default configured NSSAI를 변경하는 방법을 설명해줘.
gold_summary_ko: NAS transport procedure 중 UE parameters update transparent container를 UE에 전송하여 default configured NSSAI를 변경할 수 있다.

source_text_en: For the case when the UE has an emergency PDU session and integrity check fails, the AMF may skip the authentication procedure even if no 5G NAS security context is available and proceed directly to the execution of the security mode control procedure as specified in subclause 5.4.2.
condition: when the UE has an emergency PDU session and the integrity check fails
action: skip authentication and proceed directly to security mode control
exception: even if no 5G NAS security context is available
question_ko: emergency PDU session이 있는 UE의 integrity check가 실패했을 때 AMF의 authentication 및 security mode control 처리를 설명해줘.
gold_summary_ko: 그 조건에서 AMF는 5G NAS security context가 없어도 authentication을 생략하고 security mode control로 바로 진행할 수 있다.

source_text_en: If the timer T3526 associated with the S-NSSAI(s) was started upon reception of the rejected NSSAI for the maximum number of UEs reached, the UE may remove the S-NSSAI(s) from the rejected NSSAI including S-NSSAI(s) with the rejection cause "S-NSSAI not available due to maximum number of UEs reached", if the timer T3526 associated with the S-NSSAI(s) expires.
condition: if T3526 was started for rejected S-NSSAI(s) due to the maximum number of UEs being reached and that timer expires
action: remove the affected S-NSSAI(s) from the rejected NSSAI
exception: only S-NSSAI(s) carrying the stated maximum-UE rejection cause
question_ko: 최대 UE 수 도달 사유의 S-NSSAI와 연관된 T3526이 만료될 때 UE의 처리를 설명해줘.
gold_summary_ko: 해당 T3526이 만료되면 UE는 'maximum number of UEs reached' 거절 사유를 가진 S-NSSAI를 rejected NSSAI에서 제거할 수 있다.

source_text_en: The configured NSSAI and the rejected NSSAI may be changed during the registration procedure or the generic UE configuration update procedure.
condition: during the registration procedure or the generic UE configuration update procedure
action: be changed
question_ko: configured NSSAI와 rejected NSSAI의 변경 절차를 설명해줘.
gold_summary_ko: configured NSSAI와 rejected NSSAI는 registration procedure 또는 generic UE configuration update procedure 중 변경될 수 있다.

source_text_en: The N38 references point can be between V-SMFs in the same VPLMN, or between V-SMFs in different VPLMNs (to enable inter-PLMN mobility).
action: exist between V-SMFs in the same VPLMN or in different VPLMNs
exception: the inter-VPLMN case enables inter-PLMN mobility
question_ko: V-SMF 사이 N38 reference point의 VPLMN 배치 관계를 설명해줘.
gold_summary_ko: N38 reference point는 같은 VPLMN의 V-SMF 사이 또는 서로 다른 VPLMN의 V-SMF 사이에 존재할 수 있다.

source_text_en: Not all events can be subscribed to UPF directly.
condition: for direct subscription to the UPF
action: be subscribed to the UPF directly
exception: not all events support direct UPF subscription
question_ko: event를 UPF에 직접 subscribe하는 기능의 적용 범위를 설명해줘.
gold_summary_ko: 모든 event를 UPF에 직접 subscribe할 수 있는 것은 아니며, 일부 event에는 그 기능이 불가능하다.

source_text_en: The architecture does not require the DS-TT functionality to be supported in the device nor require the user plane NWTT functionality to be supported in the UPF, however, it can co-exist with such functions.
condition: when DS-TT in the device or NW-TT in the UPF is present
action: co-exist with DS-TT and NW-TT functions
exception: the architecture does not require those functions to be supported
question_ko: 5GS architecture와 DS-TT 또는 NW-TT function의 공존 관계를 설명해줘.
gold_summary_ko: architecture가 DS-TT나 NW-TT 지원을 요구하지는 않지만, 해당 function이 있으면 이들과 공존할 수 있다.

source_text_en: If a UDSF is shared between several NFs not part of the same set or is shared between several NF sets, it is up to UDSF implementation and deployment to make sure that only NFs that are authorized can access the data.
actor: NFs authorized to access the data
condition: if a UDSF is shared between NFs outside the same set or between multiple NF sets
action: access the data
exception: only authorized NFs can access the data; enforcement depends on UDSF implementation and deployment
question_ko: 여러 NF 또는 NF set이 UDSF를 공유할 때 데이터 접근 범위를 설명해줘.
gold_summary_ko: UDSF가 여러 NF나 NF set에 공유되면 구현·배포에 따라 권한 있는 NF만 데이터에 접근할 수 있다.

source_text_en: An UE connected to a 5G-RG or FN-RG can access to the 5GC via the N3IWF or via the TNGF where the combination of 5G-RG/FN-RG, W-AGF and UPF serving the 5G-RG or FN-RG is acting respectively as Untrusted Non-3GPP access network or as a Trusted Non-3GPP access network defined in clause 4.2.8.2; for example a UE is connecting to 5G-RG by means of WLAN radio access and connected to 5GC via N3IWF.
actor: UE connected to a 5G-RG or FN-RG
condition: where the 5G-RG/FN-RG, W-AGF, and serving UPF combination acts as the corresponding untrusted or trusted non-3GPP access network
action: access the 5GC through the N3IWF or TNGF
exception: the access path depends on whether the combination acts as untrusted or trusted non-3GPP access
question_ko: 5G-RG 또는 FN-RG에 연결된 UE의 5GC non-3GPP 접근 경로를 설명해줘.
gold_summary_ko: 해당 UE는 구성요소가 untrusted 또는 trusted non-3GPP access network로 동작하는 경우 각각 N3IWF 또는 TNGF를 통해 5GC에 접근할 수 있다.

source_text_en: A special case where the 5GS can act as a sub-network is when the 5GS acts as a TSN network, which is supported by the 3GPP specifications based on the architecture in clause 4.4.8.2.
condition: when the 5GS acts as a TSN network
action: act as a sub-network
exception: this is a special case based on the referenced TSN architecture
question_ko: 5GS가 TSN network로 동작할 때의 sub-network 역할을 설명해줘.
gold_summary_ko: 5GS가 TSN network로 동작하는 특수한 경우에는 sub-network로 동작할 수 있다.

source_text_en: To this purpose, the 5GSM messages can be transmitted in an information element in the 5GMM transport messages.
condition: for transmission via 5GMM transport messages
action: be transmitted in an information element of the 5GMM transport messages
question_ko: 5GSM message를 5GMM transport message로 전달하는 방식을 설명해줘.
gold_summary_ko: 5GSM message는 5GMM transport message의 information element 안에서 전송될 수 있다.

source_text_en: Before security can be activated, the AMF and the UE need to establish a 5G NAS security context.
condition: after the AMF and UE establish a 5G NAS security context
action: be activated
exception: security cannot be activated before that context is established
question_ko: 5G NAS security를 활성화하기 전에 AMF와 UE가 충족해야 하는 전제조건을 설명해줘.
gold_summary_ko: AMF와 UE가 5G NAS security context를 먼저 설정해야 하며, 그 전에는 security를 활성화할 수 없다.

source_text_en: The UE can provide the SOR transparent container IE during the registration procedure to the network in the REGISTRATION COMPLETE message.
condition: during the registration procedure
action: provide the SOR transparent container IE to the network in the REGISTRATION COMPLETE message
question_ko: registration procedure에서 UE가 SOR transparent container IE를 network에 전달하는 방법을 설명해줘.
gold_summary_ko: UE는 registration procedure 중 REGISTRATION COMPLETE message에 SOR transparent container IE를 넣어 network에 제공할 수 있다.

source_text_en: This current 5G NAS security context can be of type native or mapped, i.e. originating from a native 5G NAS security context or mapped 5G NAS security context.
action: be either native or mapped
question_ko: current 5G NAS security context의 유형을 설명해줘.
gold_summary_ko: current 5G NAS security context는 native 유형 또는 mapped 유형일 수 있다.

source_text_en: The 5G NAS security context which is indicated by an ngKSI can be taken into use to establish the secure exchange of NAS messages when a new N1 NAS signalling connection is established without executing a new primary authentication and key agreement procedure (see subclause 5.4.1) or when the AMF initiates a security mode control procedure.
actor: 5G NAS security context indicated by an ngKSI
condition: when a new N1 NAS signalling connection is established without new primary authentication and key agreement, or when the AMF initiates security mode control
action: be taken into use to establish secure NAS-message exchange
question_ko: ngKSI가 가리키는 5G NAS security context를 새 인증 없이 사용하는 상황을 설명해줘.
gold_summary_ko: 새 N1 NAS signalling connection을 새 primary authentication 없이 설정하거나 AMF가 security mode control을 시작할 때, 해당 context를 secure NAS exchange 설정에 사용할 수 있다.

source_text_en: As described in subclause 4.8 in order to interwork with E-UTRAN connected to EPC, the UE supporting both S1 mode and N1 mode can operate in either single-registration mode or dual-registration mode.
actor: UE supporting both S1 mode and N1 mode
condition: for interworking with E-UTRAN connected to EPC
action: operate in either single-registration mode or dual-registration mode
question_ko: S1 mode와 N1 mode를 모두 지원하는 UE의 registration mode 운용 선택지를 설명해줘.
gold_summary_ko: 해당 UE는 EPC 연결 E-UTRAN과 interwork하기 위해 single-registration mode 또는 dual-registration mode로 동작할 수 있다.

source_text_en: In order to enforce all primary RAT restrictions, the related RAT has to be deployed in different Tracking Area Codes and the subscriber shall not be allowed to access the network in TAs using the particular RAT.
condition: to enforce all primary RAT restrictions when the related RAT is deployed in different Tracking Area Codes
action: access the network in TAs using the restricted RAT
question_ko: primary RAT restriction을 적용할 때 subscriber의 해당 RAT 기반 TA 접근 제한을 설명해줘.
gold_summary_ko: 관련 RAT가 서로 다른 Tracking Area Code에 배치된 조건에서 subscriber는 그 RAT를 사용하는 TA의 network에 접근해서는 안 된다.

source_text_en: Subscriptions targeted to Any UE shall not be moved to another AMF due to UE mobility.
condition: due to UE mobility
action: be moved to another AMF
question_ko: Any UE를 대상으로 하는 subscription을 UE mobility 때문에 다른 AMF로 이동하는 정책을 설명해줘.
gold_summary_ko: Any UE 대상 subscription은 UE mobility를 이유로 다른 AMF로 이동되어서는 안 된다.

source_text_en: If the UE is performing registration over one access and intends to perform registration over the other access in the same PLMN (e.g. the 3GPP access and the selected N3IWF, TNGF or W-AGF are located in the same PLMN), the UE shall not initiate the registration over the other access until the Registration procedure over first access is completed.
condition: when already registering over one access and intending to register over the other access in the same PLMN
action: initiate registration over the other access
exception: not until registration over the first access is complete
question_ko: UE가 같은 PLMN의 한 access에서 등록 중 다른 access 등록도 하려는 경우 시작 시점을 설명해줘.
gold_summary_ko: UE는 첫 access의 registration procedure가 완료되기 전에는 다른 access의 등록을 시작해서는 안 된다.

source_text_en: The UE shall not use the entering of a Non-Allowed Area as a criterion for Cell Reselection, a trigger for PLMN Selection or Domain selection for UE originating sessions or calls.
condition: when entering a Non-Allowed Area
action: use that entry as a criterion for Cell Reselection or as a trigger for PLMN/Domain selection for UE-originating sessions or calls
question_ko: UE가 Non-Allowed Area에 진입한 사실을 cell·PLMN·domain 선택에 사용하는 정책을 설명해줘.
gold_summary_ko: UE는 Non-Allowed Area 진입을 Cell Reselection 기준이나 UE-originating session/call의 PLMN 또는 Domain selection trigger로 사용해서는 안 된다.

source_text_en: If the UE has not received any NSAG Information from the AMF, the UE shall not use Network Slice based cell reselection and Random Access at all.
condition: if the UE has not received NSAG Information from the AMF
action: use Network Slice based cell reselection and Random Access
question_ko: AMF에서 NSAG Information을 받지 못한 UE의 Network Slice 기반 cell reselection과 Random Access 처리를 설명해줘.
gold_summary_ko: UE는 NSAG Information을 받지 못하면 Network Slice 기반 cell reselection과 Random Access를 전혀 사용해서는 안 된다.

source_text_en: If the UE does not indicate preference for MICO mode during Registration procedure, the AMF shall not activate MICO mode for this UE.
condition: if the UE does not indicate a preference for MICO mode during registration
action: activate MICO mode for that UE
question_ko: registration 중 UE가 MICO mode 선호를 표시하지 않았을 때 AMF의 MICO mode 처리를 설명해줘.
gold_summary_ko: UE가 MICO mode 선호를 표시하지 않으면 AMF는 그 UE에 MICO mode를 활성화해서는 안 된다.

source_text_en: The emergency PDU session shall not be released.
action: be released
question_ko: emergency PDU session의 release 정책을 설명해줘.
gold_summary_ko: emergency PDU session은 release되어서는 안 된다.

source_text_en: The number of S-NSSAIs included in the partially allowed NSSAI or the partially rejected NSSAI shall not exceed 7.
actor: number of S-NSSAIs in the partially allowed NSSAI or partially rejected NSSAI
action: exceed 7
exception: maximum is 7
question_ko: partially allowed 또는 partially rejected NSSAI의 S-NSSAI 개수 상한을 설명해줘.
gold_summary_ko: 해당 NSSAI에 포함되는 S-NSSAI 수는 7개를 초과해서는 안 된다.

source_text_en: When a new 5G NAS security context is derived using the same K AMF, the target AMF includes the 8 least significant bits of the downlink NAS COUNT in the Intra N1 mode NAS transparent container IE, and indicates that a new KAMF shall not be derived (see subclause 9.11.2.6).
condition: when a new 5G NAS security context is derived using the same K_AMF
action: be derived
exception: the target AMF indicates this in the Intra N1 mode NAS transparent container IE
question_ko: 동일한 K_AMF로 새 5G NAS security context를 유도할 때 target AMF가 새 K_AMF 유도 여부를 어떻게 표시하는지 설명해줘.
gold_summary_ko: 그 경우 새로운 K_AMF는 유도되어서는 안 되며, target AMF는 그 사실을 container IE에 표시한다.

source_text_en: Once the secure exchange of NAS messages has been established, the receiving 5GMM entity in the UE shall not process any NAS signalling messages unless they have been successfully integrity checked by the NAS.
condition: once secure NAS-message exchange has been established
action: process NAS signalling messages
exception: unless the messages have been successfully integrity checked by NAS
question_ko: secure NAS message exchange가 설정된 뒤 UE receiving 5GMM entity의 NAS signalling message 처리 조건을 설명해줘.
gold_summary_ko: secure exchange 설정 후 UE의 receiving 5GMM entity는 NAS 무결성 검사를 성공한 message가 아니면 처리해서는 안 된다.

source_text_en: If the UE is registering or registered for onboarding services in SNPN, the serving SNPN shall not provide a configured NSSAI to the UE.
condition: if the UE is registering or registered for onboarding services in the SNPN
action: provide a configured NSSAI to the UE
question_ko: UE가 SNPN onboarding service에 등록 중이거나 등록된 경우 serving SNPN의 configured NSSAI 제공 정책을 설명해줘.
gold_summary_ko: 그 경우 serving SNPN은 UE에 configured NSSAI를 제공해서는 안 된다.

source_text_en: If the UE performs initial registration for onboarding services in SNPN or is registered for onboarding services in SNPN, the UE NAS layer shall not provide the lower layers with an NSSAI.
condition: if the UE performs initial registration for onboarding services in an SNPN or is already registered for them
action: provide the lower layers with an NSSAI
question_ko: SNPN onboarding service를 위해 initial registration을 수행하거나 이미 등록된 UE의 NAS layer가 lower layer에 NSSAI를 제공하는 정책을 설명해줘.
gold_summary_ko: 그 조건에서 UE NAS layer는 lower layer에 NSSAI를 제공해서는 안 된다.

source_text_en: The Registration Area of a UE in the Non-Allowed Area should consist of a set of TAs which belongs to a NonAllowed Area of the UE.
actor: Registration Area of a UE in a Non-Allowed Area
condition: when the UE is in a Non-Allowed Area
action: consist of a set of TAs belonging to a Non-Allowed Area of the UE
question_ko: Non-Allowed Area에 있는 UE의 Registration Area를 구성하는 TA 범위를 설명해줘.
gold_summary_ko: 해당 Registration Area는 UE의 Non-Allowed Area에 속하는 TA 집합으로 구성하는 것이 권고된다.

source_text_en: When the 5GS supports the Paging Policy Differentiation (PPD) feature, the DSCP value (TOS in IPv4 / TC in IPv6) is set by the application to indicate to the 5GS which Paging Policy should be applied for a certain IP packet.
condition: when the 5GS supports Paging Policy Differentiation, for a particular IP packet
action: be selected for application according to the DSCP value set by the application
question_ko: 5GS가 Paging Policy Differentiation을 지원할 때 특정 IP packet에 적용할 Paging Policy를 표시하는 방식을 설명해줘.
gold_summary_ko: application이 설정한 DSCP value는 특정 IP packet에 어떤 Paging Policy를 적용하는 것이 권고되는지를 5GS에 나타낸다.

source_text_en: If the NG-RAN node takes a decision to initiate UAC because of the reception of the N2 interface OVERLOAD START messages, the NG-RAN should only initiate such procedure if all the AMFs relevant to the request contained in the OVERLOAD START message and connected to this NG-RAN node request to restrict the load for UEs that access the network.
condition: if it decides to initiate UAC after receiving N2 OVERLOAD START messages
action: initiate UAC
exception: only if all relevant connected AMFs named by the request ask to restrict load for accessing UEs
question_ko: N2 OVERLOAD START 수신으로 UAC를 시작하려는 NG-RAN node가 확인할 AMF 조건을 설명해줘.
gold_summary_ko: NG-RAN node는 요청과 관련된 모든 연결 AMF가 UE load 제한을 요구할 때에만 UAC를 시작하는 것이 권고된다.

source_text_en: For 3GPP access and CM-CONNECTED state, when radio access network determines target RAT and target PLMN during Handover or redirection procedure, it should take per PLMN RAT restriction into consideration.
condition: for 3GPP access in CM-CONNECTED state when selecting target RAT and target PLMN during handover or redirection
action: take per-PLMN RAT restrictions into consideration
question_ko: CM-CONNECTED 상태의 3GPP access에서 handover 또는 redirection 중 target RAT·PLMN을 정할 때 고려할 제한을 설명해줘.
gold_summary_ko: radio access network는 target RAT와 PLMN을 정할 때 PLMN별 RAT restriction을 고려하는 것이 권고된다.

source_text_en: The allowed NSSAI(s) should be stored in a non-volatile memory in the ME as specified in annex C.
action: be stored in non-volatile memory in the ME
exception: as specified in annex C
question_ko: allowed NSSAI를 ME에 저장하는 위치와 방식을 설명해줘.
gold_summary_ko: allowed NSSAI는 annex C에 따라 ME의 non-volatile memory에 저장하는 것이 권고된다.

source_text_en: The UE should memorize the identity of the PLMNs or SNPNs where N1 mode capability for 3GPP access was disabled.
condition: where N1 mode capability for 3GPP access was disabled
action: memorize the identity of the affected PLMNs or SNPNs
question_ko: 3GPP access의 N1 mode capability가 비활성화된 경우 UE가 기억할 network identity를 설명해줘.
gold_summary_ko: UE는 N1 mode capability가 비활성화된 PLMN 또는 SNPN의 identity를 기억하는 것이 권고된다.

source_text_en: If the mapping of 5G-GUTI to SUPI in the network was incorrect, the network should respond by sending a new AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message to the UE.
condition: if the mapping from 5G-GUTI to SUPI in the network was incorrect
action: send a new AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message to the UE
question_ko: network의 5G-GUTI와 SUPI mapping이 잘못된 경우 authentication 응답 절차를 설명해줘.
gold_summary_ko: mapping이 잘못된 경우 network는 UE에 새 AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message를 보내는 것이 권고된다.

source_text_en: If the mapping of 5G-GUTI to SUPI in the network was correct, the network should terminate the 5G AKA based primary authentication and key agreement procedure by sending an AUTHENTICATION REJECT message (see subclause 5.4.1.3.5).
condition: if the mapping from 5G-GUTI to SUPI in the network was correct
action: terminate the 5G AKA primary authentication and key agreement procedure by sending an AUTHENTICATION REJECT message
question_ko: network의 5G-GUTI와 SUPI mapping이 올바른 경우 진행 중인 5G AKA 절차 처리를 설명해줘.
gold_summary_ko: mapping이 올바른 경우 network는 AUTHENTICATION REJECT message를 보내 5G AKA 기반 primary authentication and key agreement procedure를 종료하는 것이 권고된다.

source_text_en: If the disabling of N1 mode capability for 3GPP access was due to no network slices available, the UE should memorize the identity of the PLMN or SNPN where N1 mode is disabled due to no available network slices or the list of SNPNs where N1 mode is disabled due to no available network slices, respectively.
condition: if N1 mode capability for 3GPP access was disabled because no network slices were available
action: memorize the identity of the affected PLMN or SNPN, or the affected SNPN list, respectively
exception: the memorized identity or list follows the PLMN/SNPN case
question_ko: 사용 가능한 network slice가 없어 N1 mode가 비활성화된 경우 UE가 PLMN·SNPN 정보를 기억하는 방식을 설명해줘.
gold_summary_ko: UE는 원인과 대상에 따라 N1 mode가 비활성화된 PLMN 또는 SNPN의 identity나 SNPN 목록을 각각 기억하는 것이 권고된다.

source_text_en: To enable an emergency call back, the UE should wait for a UE implementation-specific duration of time before requesting the use of MICO mode after the completion of the emergency services.
condition: after completion of emergency services and before requesting MICO mode, to enable an emergency callback
action: wait for a UE-implementation-specific duration
question_ko: emergency service 완료 후 emergency callback을 지원하기 위해 UE가 MICO mode를 요청하기 전 취할 동작을 설명해줘.
gold_summary_ko: UE는 emergency service 완료 후 MICO mode를 요청하기 전에 구현별 시간 동안 기다리는 것이 권고된다.

source_text_en: The AMF should set the value of the mobile reachable timer and implicit deregistration timer based on the unavailability period duration and the start of the unavailability period.
condition: based on the unavailability-period duration and its start
action: set the mobile reachable timer and implicit deregistration timer values
question_ko: AMF가 unavailability period 정보를 이용해 mobile reachable timer와 implicit deregistration timer를 설정하는 방식을 설명해줘.
gold_summary_ko: AMF는 unavailability period의 duration과 시작 시점을 바탕으로 두 timer 값을 설정하는 것이 권고된다.

source_text_en: If the AMF does not provide the Unavailability configuration IE or the AMF sets the EUPR bit value in the Unavailability configuration IE to "UE needs to report end of unavailability period", the UE should trigger registration procedure for mobility registration update when the unavailability period duration has ended.
condition: if the AMF omits the Unavailability configuration IE or sets EUPR to require an end-of-period report, when the unavailability duration ends
action: trigger registration for mobility registration update
question_ko: Unavailability configuration IE가 없거나 EUPR이 종료 보고를 요구할 때 unavailability period 종료 후 UE 동작을 설명해줘.
gold_summary_ko: 해당 조건에서 unavailability period가 끝나면 UE는 mobility registration update를 위한 registration procedure를 시작하는 것이 권고된다.

source_text_en: Forbidden Areas should not be used for Untrusted or Trusted non-3GPP access.
condition: for untrusted or trusted non-3GPP access
action: be used
question_ko: Forbidden Area를 untrusted 또는 trusted non-3GPP access에 적용하는 정책을 설명해줘.
gold_summary_ko: Forbidden Area는 untrusted 또는 trusted non-3GPP access에 사용하지 않는 것이 권고된다.

source_text_en: In uncongested scenarios, 98 percent of the packets should not experience a delay exceeding the 5QI's PDB.
condition: in uncongested scenarios
action: experience a delay exceeding the 5QI Packet Delay Budget
exception: up to 2 percent of packets are outside the stated recommendation
question_ko: 혼잡하지 않은 상황에서 5QI Packet Delay Budget을 초과하는 packet delay 비율 기준을 설명해줘.
gold_summary_ko: 혼잡하지 않은 상황에서는 packet의 98%가 5QI PDB를 넘는 지연을 겪지 않는 것이 권고된다.

source_text_en: The AMF should not reject the request or deregister the UE unless it has sufficiently accurate UE location information to determine that the UE is located in a geographical area where the PLMN is not allowed to operate.
condition: when handling the request and the UE
action: reject the request or deregister the UE
exception: unless sufficiently accurate location information shows that the UE is in an area where the PLMN may not operate
question_ko: PLMN 운용 제한 지역과 관련된 UE 요청을 AMF가 처리할 때 필요한 위치정보 조건을 설명해줘.
gold_summary_ko: AMF는 UE가 PLMN 운용 금지 지역에 있다고 판단할 만큼 정확한 위치정보가 없는 한 요청을 reject하거나 UE를 deregister하지 않는 것이 권고된다.

source_text_en: A dual-registered UE should not send its E-UTRA connected to 5GC and E-UTRAN radio capabilities to NR access when connected to 5GS/NR to avoid being handed over to 5GC-connected E-UTRA or to E-UTRAN.
condition: when connected to 5GS/NR
action: send its E-UTRA-to-5GC and E-UTRAN radio capabilities to NR access
exception: to avoid handover to 5GC-connected E-UTRA or E-UTRAN
question_ko: dual-registered UE가 5GS/NR에 연결됐을 때 NR access로 전송할 E-UTRA·E-UTRAN radio capability 정책을 설명해줘.
gold_summary_ko: 해당 UE는 원치 않는 handover를 피하기 위해 그 radio capability를 NR access로 보내지 않는 것이 권고된다.

source_text_en: The network should not move the UE to another available PLMN/SNPN, e.g. by handover, as long as the selected PLMN/SNPN is available to serve the UE's location.
condition: as long as the selected PLMN or SNPN remains available at the UE location
action: move the UE to another available PLMN or SNPN, including by handover
question_ko: 선택된 PLMN 또는 SNPN이 UE 위치에서 계속 서비스를 제공하는 동안 다른 network로 이동시키는 정책을 설명해줘.
gold_summary_ko: 선택된 PLMN 또는 SNPN이 계속 서비스 가능하면 network는 UE를 다른 PLMN 또는 SNPN으로 이동시키지 않는 것이 권고된다.

source_text_en: The AMF should not reject Registration Request message for Mobility Registration Update that are performed when the UE is already in CM-CONNECTED state.
condition: when a UE already in CM-CONNECTED performs a Registration Request for Mobility Registration Update
action: reject the Registration Request
question_ko: 이미 CM-CONNECTED인 UE가 Mobility Registration Update용 Registration Request를 보낼 때 AMF의 reject 정책을 설명해줘.
gold_summary_ko: 그 경우 AMF는 Registration Request를 reject하지 않는 것이 권고된다.

source_text_en: To redirect a UE from 5GC to EPC, when the UE sends a Registration Request or Service Request, the AMF sends a Registration Reject or Service Reject with an EMM cause value indicating that the UE should not use 5GC.
condition: when redirecting the UE from 5GC to EPC after a Registration Request or Service Request
action: use 5GC
exception: the AMF conveys this in the EMM cause of a Registration Reject or Service Reject
question_ko: UE를 5GC에서 EPC로 redirect할 때 AMF가 reject message의 EMM cause로 전달하는 5GC 사용 지침을 설명해줘.
gold_summary_ko: AMF는 reject message의 EMM cause를 통해 UE가 5GC를 사용하지 않는 것이 권고된다는 뜻을 전달한다.

source_text_en: To avoid paging in the entire PLMN, when the AMF allocates the Active Time the AMF should not allocate "all PLMN" registration area to the UE.
condition: when allocating Active Time, to avoid paging across the entire PLMN
action: allocate an 'all PLMN' registration area to the UE
question_ko: 전체 PLMN paging을 피하기 위해 AMF가 Active Time을 할당할 때 registration area를 정하는 정책을 설명해줘.
gold_summary_ko: AMF는 Active Time 할당 시 UE에 'all PLMN' registration area를 할당하지 않는 것이 권고된다.

source_text_en: If the AMF indicates active time value to the UE, AMF should not indicate "all PLMN registration area allocated" indication in the MICO indication IE to the UE.
condition: if the AMF indicates an active-time value to the UE
action: indicate 'all PLMN registration area allocated' in the MICO indication IE
question_ko: AMF가 UE에 active time value를 알릴 때 MICO indication IE의 all-PLMN 표시에 관한 정책을 설명해줘.
gold_summary_ko: 그 경우 AMF는 MICO indication IE에 'all PLMN registration area allocated'를 표시하지 않는 것이 권고된다.

source_text_en: The AMF should not reject the following: a) requests for emergency services; b) requests for emergency services fallback; c) requests from UEs configured for high priority access in selected PLMN or SNPN; d) DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message; e) requests for mobile terminated services, triggered by paging or a notification procedure; f) requests for initial registration or mobility and periodic registration update, when emergency is indicated by lower layers; and g) requests for mobility registration update when the UE is reporting unavailability information due to discontinuous coverage.
source_normalization_note: PDF text-extraction intra-word space removed after visual/source-line check
condition: during 5GMM signalling congestion control
action: reject emergency, emergency-fallback, high-priority, deregistration, mobile-terminated, emergency-indicated registration, or discontinuous-coverage update requests listed in the sentence
exception: the non-rejection recommendation is limited to the seven listed request classes
question_ko: 5GMM signalling congestion 상황에서 AMF가 예외적으로 다루는 request 범주를 설명해줘.
gold_summary_ko: AMF는 emergency·fallback·high-priority·deregistration·mobile-terminated service 및 명시된 emergency·discontinuous-coverage 관련 registration request를 reject하지 않는 것이 권고된다.

source_text_en: If the UE is authorized to use V2X communication over PC5 reference point based on: a) at least one of the following bits in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message set by the UE, or already stored in the 5GMM context in the AMF during the previous registration procedure as follows: 1) the V2XCEPC5 bit to "V2X communication over E-UTRA-PC5 supported"; or 2) the V2XCNPC5 bit to "V2X communication over NR-PC5 supported"; and b) the user's subscription context obtained from the UDM as defined in 3GPP TS 23.287 [6C]; the AMF should not immediately release the NAS signalling connection after the completion of the registration procedure.
condition: if the UE is authorized for V2X communication over PC5 by the stated capability bits and subscription context
action: immediately release the NAS signalling connection after registration completes
question_ko: UE가 capability bit와 subscription context에 따라 PC5 기반 V2X communication 권한을 가진 경우 registration 완료 후 NAS signalling connection 처리 정책을 설명해줘.
gold_summary_ko: 그 조건에서 AMF는 registration 완료 직후 NAS signalling connection을 해제하지 않는 것이 권고된다.

source_text_en: The UE should not request to join a multicast MBS session for local MBS service if neither current TAI nor CGI of the current cell is part of the MBS service area(s) of the multicast MBS session, if the UE has valid information of the MBS service area(s) of the multicast MBS session.
condition: if the UE has valid MBS service-area information and neither the current TAI nor current-cell CGI is in the multicast session service area
action: request to join the multicast MBS session for local MBS service
question_ko: 현재 TAI와 cell CGI가 multicast MBS session service area에 없고 UE가 유효한 area 정보를 가진 경우 join request 정책을 설명해줘.
gold_summary_ko: 그 조건에서 UE는 local MBS service의 multicast MBS session 참가를 요청하지 않는 것이 권고된다.
